patch_description: Restructure into a wide multi-start funnel: (1) fast vectorized scoring kernel shared by all stages, (2) ~72 deterministic random-base seeds (4-point bases expanded by 3-fold symmetry, plus circle/ring/lattice inits) refined by a short vectorized softmin gradient ascent, (3) exact hill-climb polish on the top-10 candidates with per-point directional moves. The architecture separates kernel / candidate-generator / refiner / selector into distinct stages with data flowing through a sorted candidate pool, using the large runtime headroom (budget 30–40s vs previous 1.6s) to multiply start breadth, which is what historically broke score plateaus.
